name: Radiance Technologies
old_description: Our employee-owners can be trusted and they trust their teammates to do the “right thing”
about:
Radiance Technologies was founded on March 15, 1999, by George Clark, John Dennis, and Scott Dublin in a 3,000‑square‑foot office in Huntsville, Alabama. The trio set out to build an employee‑owned firm focused on technology and operational relevance for the U.S. Army’s Space and Missile Defense Command. The company is now headquartered in Ruston, Louisiana, and remains 100 % employee‑owned.

Today Radiance delivers intelligence analysis, cyber operations, directed‑energy (HEL/HPM) systems, hypersonics development, space communications and ISR, AI/ML for sensor data, and modeling‑and‑simulation support. It also runs a manufacturing complex capable of prototyping, low‑rate initial production, and hardware/software reverse engineering. The firm employs over 500 people across corporate facilities in nine states and project offices in fourteen states and one foreign country; intelligence work accounts for roughly 40 % of revenue.

Primary customers include the U.S. Army SMDC, the Intelligence Community, INSCOM, SOCCOM, NASA, and other DoD agencies. Testimonials cite the Chief of the Army’s High Energy Laser Division, the 116th MI Brigade Commander, and INSCOM’s G3 AISR Division Director as references.

The founders’ original goal – to prioritize the customer’s mission over profit, trust employee‑owners to do the “right thing,” and tackle problems others call impossible – still drives the culture. Employee ownership is cited as a differentiator that aligns workforce incentives with game‑changing solutions.
